page: Microsoft Azure D96ads_v7 is a general-purpose server instance belonging to the Dadsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 48 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor, operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including AVX512_VNNI and AVX512_BF16) and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is provided by a 5669 GB local NVMe SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, the D96ads_v7 demonstrates top-tier performance characteristics. Both single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng place the instance in the top 10% of tested hardware. Memory subsystem performance is highly competitive, with small-block cached read bandwidth reaching 9486.57 GB/sec and large-block uncached write bandwidth recorded at 174.65 GB/sec. Database and transactional operations are highly efficient, as evidenced by a Passmark database score in the top 10% and Redis SET operations executing at 140.26 million operations per second. The instance also exhibits strong capabilities in text processing and compression, with bzip3 multi-threaded decompression reaching 610.83 GB/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the D96ads_v7 offers a balanced hardware profile that combines high-frequency dedicated compute cores with substantial local NVMe storage. This configuration avoids the premium costs associated with specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated instances while delivering top-tier performance across general compute tasks. The combination of high-speed AMD EPYC processing, fast local NVMe storage, and balanced memory capacity makes this instance highly suitable for relational databases, high-throughput Redis caching layers, static web serving, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
description: The Microsoft Azure D96ads_v7 is a general-purpose server instance powered by a 96-vCPU AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running at 4.5 GHz on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 384.0 GB of RAM and a 5669 GB local NVMe SSD, offering a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance delivers top-tier performance, with stress-ng CPU benchmarks and Passmark database operations ranking in the top 10%. It also achieves high-throughput Redis SET operations at 140.26 million operations per second and strong LLM inference speeds. Lacking a GPU, it relies on its high-frequency x86_64 architecture and AVX-512 instructions for compute tasks. This hardware profile is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring a balance of high-frequency compute, fast local storage, and substantial memory, making it an optimal fit for databases, web serving, and data processing.
